This position is the pharmacy manager for UC Davis Comprehensive Cancer Center and PCH Infusion Pharmacy areas. The Manager works closely with the Oncology/IDS Assistant Chief to identify areas of improvement and solutions, ensure regulatory compliance and operational effectiveness and efficiency. The Infusion Pharmacy Manager ensures Infusion pharmacy areas maintain compliance with State and Federal regulations, Joint Commission and professional practice standards, as well as University and department policies, procedures and standards. The Infusion Pharmacy Manager is also responsible for supervision of pharmacist and technician supervisors and staff. The Infusion Pharmacy Manager maintains oversight of documentation and assessment of staff competency and training. The Infusion Manager works closely with the Assistant Chief Pharmacist and Infusion pharmacy staff to facilitate optimum drug utilization, preparation and waste; oversees operational aspects of Outpatient Oncology and Infusion pharmacy services, inventory control and regulatory compliance. Assists the Chief Pharmacist and other members of the management team to plan, implement and monitor new programs and processes that improve the efficiency and effectiveness of pharmacy services. Plans and coordinates the development of pharmacists and technicians to meet regulatory requirements and patient needs. Serves as departmental liaison with Patient Care Services and other departments. Participates on departmental and interdisciplinary committees. #CA-DS
